questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: कृषि भूगोलसम्बन्धी कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: कृषि उत्पादनमा जलवायु र माटोको कुनै भूमिका हुँदैन
तापक्रम र वर्षाले बालीको प्रकार र उत्पादनमा प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ
सिँचाइले पानीको उपलब्धता बढाएर कृषि उत्पादनमा सहयोग गर्न सक्छ
माटोको गुणस्तर कृषि उत्पादनसँग सम्बन्धित हुन सक्छ
questions.explanation: जलवायु, माटो, पानी र स्थलरूप कृषि भूगोलका महत्वपूर्ण पक्ष हुन्।

व्यापारिक मार्गमा दूरीको कुनै प्रभाव हुँदैन
भौगोलिक chokepoint को व्यापारसँग कुनै सम्बन्ध हुँदैन
questions.explanation: महत्वपूर्ण समुद्री तथा स्थल व्यापारिक मार्गको अवस्थिति ढुवानी समय, लागत र रणनीतिक महत्वसँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका मध्ये कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: Convergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्कातर्फ सर्छन्
Divergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू अलग हुन सक्छन्
सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्
Transform boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्काको समानान्तर दिशामा सर्न सक्छन्
questions.explanation: भूकम्प विभिन्न प्रकारका प्लेट सीमामा हुन सक्छन्; त्यसैले सबै भूकम्प divergent boundary मै हुन्छन् भन्ने भनाइ गलत हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D — सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्।

questions.question: A project team needs exactly three skills: legal, financial and technical. Candidate pairs are: A has legal+financial; B has financial+technical; C has legal+technical; D has legal only. Which pair of candidates covers all three skills?
questions.solution: A supplies legal and financial, while B supplies financial and technical; together all three skills are covered.

questions.question: Statements: No inspectors are clerks. Some clerks are accountants. Conclusions: I. Some accountants are not inspectors. II. No accountant is an inspector.
questions.solution: The clerks who are accountants cannot be inspectors, so some accountants are not inspectors. Nothing establishes that every accountant is a clerk.

questions.question: Assertion (A): A department should keep a backup of important digital records. Reason (R): Digital records can become inaccessible because of hardware failure or other technical problems.
options: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.solution: Technical failure is a direct reason why backup copies are needed.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Is integer n positive? Statement I: n² = 9. Statement II: n is not equal to -3.
questions.solution: I gives n = 3 or -3. II excludes -3, so together n=3 and is positive.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five reports P, Q, R, S and T are arranged from first to last. P is before R. Q is after S. T is before P. Which report can be first?
questions.solution: T must be before P, and P before R; Q must be after S. Therefore T can be first.

questions.question: The reason ___ the project was delayed was lack of funding.
questions.solution: The standard construction is the reason why something happened.

questions.question: The evidence was incomplete; ___, the committee postponed its decision.
questions.solution: Therefore expresses the result: because the evidence was incomplete, the decision was postponed.
